name: Chromium
description: The open-source browser behind Google Chrome, from Debian. Every site sees only this mini VM's exit, in its time zone.
changelog: Opens again after its window was closed (a stale profile lock made it quit at once).
securityNotes: Clipboard for copy and paste, Shared for downloads and uploads. Runs with --no-sandbox: the mini VM container allows no user namespaces or setuid, so Chromium's own sandbox can't start; the container and the mini VM are the isolation.
